steps: Title: One Term, 2026 era, Hard, took office as Ukraine
Played 14 of 48 months mostly with Approve staff picks + Execute
Opened All orders, forecasts, Buy weapons; opened score breakdown
scenarios.notes: Understood most limits (capital seals, 6 orders, budget share), but staff-attended meetings changed state without a clear rule, and I did not reach the election.

steps: Approve-all every month: score slid 100 to 85, never near the 115 bonus
Tried Buy weapons once: front +3 that month
scenarios.notes: No evidence of one winning move yet; the passive line loses slowly. Did not get enough months to test a repeated move.

friction.happened: Substring click on '2026' matched Today's Crisis and started a Hormuz Flashpoint (driver artifact, but shows two '2026' targets)

friction.where: Month 1 desk, Sanctions on Iran as Ukraine
friction.expected: Crisis relevant to a country at war with Russia
friction.happened: UN vote on Iran sanctions as first Ukraine decision; outcome quote about crowds at the Ukrainian embassy in Iran
BACKFIRED label with -15 in green mint, same colour as good results

friction.where: Desk, Add button on advisor suggestion
friction.happened: My click by label did not register; debrief said 0 orders (possible retry)

friction.where: Debrief Home and security, Staff meeting card
friction.happened: Meeting stamped FAILED yet Mobilization rose 85 to 95 and troops grew; I never ordered mobilization, staff did via Approve
Capital showed 2 left, then 4 of 4, then 5 of 6 with 'next month 2 more' then '1 more'; hard to model
Art shows GDP +0.3% for the option that hurts the economy
Sanctions on Iran and Grid down repeat from months 1 and 2
Debrief 'FEB 2027' while the new desk said Feb 2027 month 4 after Jan month 3; label lags one month

friction.expected: Names I do not know explained
friction.happened: Mojtaba Khamenei, IRGC, Takaichi, Frederiksen, Kramatorsk shown; 'i' chips and codex offered; I did not need them but they were unobtrusive

bugs.title: Staff-attended meeting stamped FAILED while its effects apply
steps: Desk, Approve staff picks incl. Defence Minister meeting
Execute, open See everything, Home and security
bugs.expected: Result and stamp agree, and I am told I authorised mobilization
bugs.actual: FAILED stamp with +10 mobilization and -2 approval

bugs.title: Backfire shown in positive green
steps: Choose Vote for sanctions in month 1

bugs.title: Economy growth reads -5 to -9% yet score economy part only gently falls
bugs.actual: Header shows economy -9.2%, approval 71%, score changes 1 per month

suggestions.what: Show the exact rule when a staff action changes state without my order, and list what Approve will do before I press it
suggestions.goal_served: Find out why every number moved

suggestions.what: Let advisor orders be added by one click and show the preview inline; fix capital refill wording
suggestions.goal_served: Understand every rule that limits me

suggestions.what: Add a month-by-month history table of the four score components with causes

delight: Score breakdown modal with per-term numbers and heading targets (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-02/shots/dan-term/015-score.png)
How much? chips showing numeric sizes (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-02/shots/dan-term/011-how.png)
Defense budget share on orders with Forecast (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-02/shots/dan-term/028-bw.png)
1990 era globe truly shows the Soviet Union and Warsaw Pact (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-02/shots/dan-term/003-era1990.png)

fun.reason: Systems are legible but 14 months on Approve-all felt like autopilot.

clarity.reason: Score modal and How much? answer why numbers moved; capital and FAILED stamp muddy it.

visual.reason: Broadcast scenes and globe are strong, a few art mismatches.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Real orders, budgets and forecasts, but the quiet months are thin.

agency.reason: Staff auto-picks and meetings act on my behalf with state changes I did not choose.

realism.reason: Ukraine opening with Iran sanctions and repeating crises dent it.

replay.reason: Want another country and Hard, but repeats show by month 12.

recommend.reason: Promising transparency; I need to see depth over a full term before telling Paradox friends.

verbatim: The numbers are honest, I will give it that. But let me press Approve and the game plays itself, and I still cannot tell you whether there is a move that always wins.
